rules.text: Keep repository-guidance compliance separate from the fixed Jev quality scorecard. Guidance verdicts must not be stored as fixed quality metrics or converted into file-and-line review findings without location evidence.

question.instructions: Does this change mix repository-guidance verdicts into the fixed Jev quality metrics, or turn a scalar guidance verdict into a file-and-line review finding without concrete location evidence?

rules.text: Validate persisted artifacts, model responses, and external workflow inputs at their trust boundary before using them.

question.instructions: Does this change consume a persisted artifact, model response, or external workflow input without validating its structure and allowed values at the boundary?

rules.text: A workflow action must be registered consistently in the supported-action list, option validation, runtime dispatch, and retry-policy tests.

check.reason: Requires repository-wide comparison across the action registries and tests.

rules.text: Mandatory Quality Gate (after every code change): npm run check:all.

check.reason: Requires observing the development process rather than the completed diff.
